entities.name: Joanna
entities.description: A screenwriter and the other half of this conversation with Nate, which runs from January to November 2022. She finished her first full screenplay in January 2022, a second in March, a third in May, and a book in late September; scripts she contributed to reached the big screen three times during 2022 and she began filming her own road-trip movie in November. She acted before she wrote, is allergic to furry animals, reptiles and cockroaches, is lactose intolerant, hikes for inspiration, bakes dairy-free desserts, joined a writers group in April 2022 and had a dog called Tilly in Michigan as a child.

entities.name: Nate
entities.description: A competitive video gamer and Joanna's friend, and the other half of this conversation, which runs from January to November 2022. He won his first tournament in January 2022 and by August was making a living from gaming; he keeps turtles, adopted a dog called Max in May 2022, dyed his hair purple in April 2022, makes dairy-free and vegan desserts, appeared on his own cooking show in September 2022 and started a gaming YouTube channel in November 2022. He took his turtles to the beach in Tampa in November 2022.

entities.name: Joanna's family

properties.aliases: my family, my family and friends

entities.description: A group entity for Joanna's family, whom the conversation never names individually. They are the people she bakes her dairy-free desserts for and tests recipes on, a photograph of them hangs on her cork board as a daily reminder of their love and encouragement, and they were the household that had to give up her childhood dog Tilly in Michigan when her allergy appeared.

entities.name: Nate's gaming friends

properties.aliases: the guys at the tournament, my tournament friends, the people at the convention

entities.description: A group entity for the fellow gamers Nate met through competition, whom the conversation never names individually. He began spending time with the more relaxed competitors at a tournament in January 2022, met more at a regional tournament in May who asked him for tips, invited them along with old teammates to his gaming party in June 2022, made more at a game convention in October 2022, and was helping friends reset their high scores at the international tournament in November 2022.

entities.name: Nate's turtles

properties.aliases: my little dudes, these little guys, my little buddies, the critters

entities.description: A group entity for Nate's turtles, which he has never named individually. There were two of them as of January 2022, kept for three years by then, and a third arrived from a pet store in November 2022. They calm him when he is nervous, got a larger tank in August 2022, eat vegetables, fruit and insects, have distinct personalities — one adventurous, one reserved — and he has walked them, brought them into the kitchen while he cooks and taken them to the beach in Tampa. Joanna cannot go near them because of her allergy, so he sends her photographs instead.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: The adopted dog Nate brought home shortly before 20 May 2022. He is full of energy, keeps Nate's turtles active, and on a walk in May 2022 he and Nate met a nearby couple with a dog, which led to arranged doggy playdates.

entities.name: Tilly
entities.description: The stuffed toy dog Nate gave Joanna on 25 May 2022 as a reminder of good vibes. She named it Tilly after a dog she had in Michigan as a child, and it sits with her while she writes, helping her stay focused.

entities.name: Nate's Iron Man figure
entities.description: A toy Iron Man Nate keeps in his room. He bought it because it reminds him of something he loves, and its presence reminds him to keep working on his goals; Iron Man is his favourite superhero for the tech and the sarcastic humour.

entities.name: Joanna's cork board
entities.description: The board in Joanna's room covered with inspiring quotes, photographs and keepsakes, which she calls her little corner of inspiration. A photograph of her family hangs on it. She showed it to Nate on 5 June 2022 and he said he should start one of his own.

entities.name: Nate's gaming setup
entities.description: The gaming room and computer Nate practises and competes on at home, first shown to Joanna on 2 May 2022 and upgraded with new equipment shortly before 7 November 2022. He calls it his own little haven and says it is essential to his career because without it he could not beat his competition.

entities.name: Michigan
entities.description: Where Joanna had a dog called Tilly as a child, before she became allergic and the family had to give the dog up. It is the only place the conversation attaches to her earlier life.

entities.name: Woodhaven
entities.description: A small town in the Midwest that Joanna visited on a research road trip in early July 2022. She saw its scenery and historic buildings and read a book from the 1900s about its people in the town library; how much the town had changed sparked the ideas for her next script.

entities.name: Woodhaven library
entities.description: The library in Woodhaven that Joanna visited on her July 2022 research road trip, which holds an old book collection. She found a volume from the 1900s there with stories and sketches about the town and the people who lived in it.

entities.name: Whispering Falls
entities.description: The waterfall Joanna photographed on a hike near her town in May 2022. She called it peaceful and serene, said the rush of the water was soothing, and that standing there made everything else fade away.

entities.name: Fort Wayne
entities.description: The city Joanna was near when she took a photograph of a sunflower at sunset on a hike in the summer of 2022, which she showed Nate on 9 November 2022.

entities.name: Tampa
entities.description: Where Nate took his turtles to the beach on 10 November 2022. It is the only place the conversation puts him near.

entities.name: Joanna's writers group

properties.aliases: my writers group, my writing club

entities.description: The group of writers Joanna joined shortly before 21 April 2022, whose members she describes as inspirational people who understand her writing and where she finally feels she belongs. She works on the script Finding Home with them, shared her book with them in August 2022 and got great feedback, and made a bookmark for one of the women in it in October 2022.

entities.name: Nate's vegan diet group
entities.description: The group Nate belongs to and shared his vegan ice cream with on 17 June 2022.

entities.name: Nate's cooking show
entities.description: Nate's dairy-free dessert teaching, which the conversation mentions twice: he said in August 2022 that he had started teaching people how to make his desserts, and on 14 September 2022 that he had taught vegan ice cream recipes on his own cooking show the previous Monday. Coconut milk ice cream is his favourite dish from it, and he picked up new recipes doing it.

entities.name: Nate's gaming YouTube channel
entities.description: The gaming content Nate started making for YouTube in November 2022, as a way to entertain people and satisfy his gaming cravings when no tournaments are running, and to connect with others who love games. Joanna advised him to watch other people's videos first, which he was already doing.

entities.name: writing
entities.description: Joanna's central occupation and the thing she says she cannot imagine life without: screenplays, a book, a blog, a journal and her written-down memories. She describes it as an escape, a way to express feelings and to create worlds and characters, and says she writes best when being true to herself even when the material is hard.

entities.name: hiking
entities.description: Joanna's way of resetting and finding inspiration. She found a trail in her hometown in April 2022 and more in her town in May 2022, photographed Whispering Falls and a Fort Wayne sunset, hiked with friends in June 2022, and says nature makes her worries vanish and makes her want to write. Nate is not into hiking but said he might go with her.

entities.name: reading
entities.description: A hobby both of them have. Joanna read a lot in April 2022, rediscovering books she had forgotten she owned, and keeps a bookshelf of books and magazines as her go-to source of writing inspiration; Nate asks her for book recommendations and has shelves of his own.

entities.name: watching films
entities.description: A hobby both of them share and trade recommendations on throughout 2022. Joanna prefers dramas and romantic comedies and Nate action, science fiction and fantasy; he says films take him to new worlds and are good for winding down, and she prefers watching at home on a comfortable couch to the cinema.

entities.name: acting
entities.description: Joanna's first passion, before writing. She forgot her lines in her first play because she was so nervous, which taught her to prepare and stay in the moment; by April 2022 she said writing is where she really shines, while not ruling out returning to acting one day.

entities.name: competitive video gaming
entities.description: Nate's main pursuit, and from mid-2022 his living. It runs from a first tournament win in January 2022 through local, regional, online and international wins to a Valorant championship in November 2022, with setbacks in September and November; he also plays for escape rather than competitively, practises at home, helps other players improve and started making gaming videos.

entities.name: dairy-free baking
entities.description: The craft both of them share. Nate discovered coconut milk ice cream in February 2022, taught it on a cooking show and shared vegan versions with his diet group; Joanna, who is lactose intolerant, took it up after his coconut recommendation and by autumn 2022 was making cakes, tarts, cupcakes, cookies and pies with almond flour, coconut oil, coconut and almond milk for her family and friends.

entities.name: Joanna's animal allergy
entities.description: A severe allergy that makes Joanna's face puffy and itchy around certain animals, so she has always stayed away from them. It covers most reptiles and animals with fur, and she found out in early 2022 that she is allergic to cockroaches as well. It is why she has no pets, why her childhood dog Tilly had to go, and why she can only watch Nate's turtles from a distance or in photographs.

entities.name: Joanna's lactose intolerance
entities.description: Joanna cannot have dairy, which is why she asked Nate for dairy-free recipes from February 2022 onwards and why all her own baking uses coconut or almond milk. She calls dairy-free a must for her, especially in desserts.

entities.name: Joanna's first screenplay
entities.description: Joanna's first full screenplay, a mix of drama and romance, which she finished and printed on 21 January 2022 after working on it for a long time. She submitted it to film festivals hoping producers and directors would pick it up, and it was still on her mind daily in February 2022.

entities.name: Joanna's second screenplay

properties.aliases: the road-trip script, my second script

entities.description: The screenplay Joanna started around 25 February 2022 and finished by 18 March 2022, about a thirty-year-old woman on a journey of self-discovery after a loss who takes a road trip to heal and grow. She called it her own story, drawn from her personal experiences, and on 11 November 2022 she was filming her own movie from it.

entities.name: Finding Home

properties.aliases: my third one, the third screenplay

entities.description: The script Joanna was writing with her writers group from April 2022, about a girl on a journey to find her true home. Joined here with the screenplay she finished and showed Nate on 20 May 2022 and called her third — the dates run consecutively and the themes she gave for it, loss, identity and connection in a personal story she had held for ages, match; the conversation never says in so many words that they are the same script.

entities.name: Joanna's book
entities.description: The book Joanna started writing in the weeks before 10 July 2022, after one of her films did well. Its dialogue explores loss, redemption and forgiveness; she had never tried publishing a book before and thought this might be her first. She shared it with her writers group in August 2022 to great feedback and finished writing it at the end of September 2022 after many late nights and edits.

entities.name: Joanna's love-story script
entities.description: The film script Joanna was writing in November 2022, a love story with many challenges that she got the idea for from a dream and hoped to get onto the big screen. She put a letter her brother had written her as a child at the beginning of its introduction.

entities.name: Joanna's Midwestern thriller script
entities.description: A suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town that Joanna was writing in November 2022 and called a great creative outlet. Joined here with the next script she said in July 2022 that Woodhaven, a small Midwestern town, had sparked the ideas for and which she expected to be different from her previous work; the conversation never states the link directly.

entities.name: the romantic drama about memory and relationships

properties.aliases: that romantic drama, the movie about memory and relationships

entities.description: A film Joanna recommended to Nate on 21 January 2022, never named in the conversation. It is one of her favourites, about memory and relationships; she first watched it around 2019, bought a physical copy, has seen it a few times and likes its idea and its acting. Nate said he loves classics and would check it out.

entities.name: Little Women
entities.description: The film Joanna recommended to Nate on 7 February 2022, calling it a great story about sisterhood, love and reaching for your dreams. Nate watched it shortly before 6 October 2022 and thought the acting and the story were great.

entities.name: The Lord of the Rings

properties.aliases: LOTR, the trilogy, The Lord of the Rings Trilogy

entities.description: The fantasy trilogy Nate named as one of his favourites on 21 April 2022, praising its world building, battles and storytelling. Joanna watched it on his recommendation on the evening of 1 May 2022 and thought it was awesome; Nate calls it probably the greatest trilogy of all time.

entities.name: Inception
entities.description: The film Nate saw shortly before 9 October 2022, which he said blew his mind with its twists and dream material.

entities.name: Counter-Strike: Global Offensive
entities.description: The team shooter Nate won his first video game tournament with in January 2022, and his usual competitive game.

entities.name: Street Fighter
entities.description: The fighting game Nate won his second tournament with, at a local event in the week before 2 May 2022. He plays it often with friends and discovered from the win that he is really good at it.

entities.name: Valorant
entities.description: The game of the big tournament Nate won the final of on 5 November 2022, where he saw his name as the champion.

entities.name: Cyberpunk 2077
entities.description: The game Nate had been playing nonstop as of 9 October 2022, for its futuristic setting and gameplay.

entities.name: Xenoblade Chronicles
entities.description: The fantasy role-playing game Nate was playing and recommending to Joanna on 7 November 2022. It is a Japanese Nintendo series, and he had wanted to play it for a while because friends recommended it.

entities.name: Catan
entities.description: The strategy board game of building settlements and trading resources that Nate loves and played with people he met at the game convention on 7 October 2022. He says it can be both competitive and relaxed.

claims.text: Joanna finished another screenplay shortly before 20 May 2022 and called it a pretty wild journey.

claims.text: Nate adopted an energetic dog called Max shortly before 20 May 2022; he said Max was filling his life with joy and keeping his other pets active.

claims.text: Joanna said on 20 May 2022 that her allergies mean she does not really want a pet and that she is too lazy to research alternative animals that would suit them.

claims.text: Writing and creative projects are what get Joanna through tough times, and she said on 20 May 2022 that she is grateful for supportive friends who understand her work, appreciate it and give her feedback on it.

claims.text: Joanna showed Nate her third screenplay on 20 May 2022, saying it had been quite a journey but she had made it.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna's third screenplay is about loss, identity and connection; she told Nate on 20 May 2022 that it is deeply personal, a story she had held for ages and only just found the guts to write, and that she was proud of it.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said on 20 May 2022 that meaningful stories come from personal experiences and feelings, and that she writes best when she is being true to herself even when it is hard and frightening.

claims.text: Joanna told Nate on 20 May 2022 that knowing she had people like him cheering her on made the writing journey much easier.

claims.text: While walking Max shortly before 25 May 2022 Nate met a friendly couple who live close by and have a dog, and they agreed to hold doggy playdates.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate said on 25 May 2022 that the dog-walking couple he had met had little in common with him beyond a love of animals, and that this was all they needed to be good friends.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate enjoys watching the dogs play together and said on 25 May 2022 that seeing Max so happy was like a dream come true.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate gave Joanna a stuffed toy dog on 25 May 2022 to remind her of good vibes, and she said she would cherish it with all her heart.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna and Nate agreed on 25 May 2022 that noticing and cherishing small joys is what keeps life good, and that it is easy to get down without them.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Looking back at the hard parts of finishing her screenplay made Joanna realise it was the small moments of joy that made the journey worth it, and on 25 May 2022 she said she could not wait to show the script to Nate because she valued his opinion.

claims.text: Joanna was sent a generic rejection letter by a major company for a screenplay she had finished, shortly before 3 June 2022; it came with no feedback, which she found disheartening because she could not tell why it had not worked out.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said on 3 June 2022 that she would not let the rejection bring her down.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate won another regional video game tournament in the week before 3 June 2022 and met new people there; he called the win a huge confidence boost that showed his hard work was paying off.

claims.text: Joanna told Nate on 3 June 2022 that she had enjoyed hearing about his tournaments over the years and was there for him every step of the way.

claims.text: Iron Man is Nate's favourite superhero, for his tech and sarcastic humour, and he keeps an Iron Man figure in his room that he bought because it reminded him of something he loves and that reminds him to keep working on his goals.

claims.text: Nate won his fourth video game tournament, which was held online, on Friday 8 July 2022, and said the victory was indescribable and that he was proud to be making money doing what he loves.

claims.text: By 14 August 2022 Joanna was going all out on her writing projects, calling it the best thing ever, a mix of highs and lows, with her journal as her rock and writing a huge part of who she is.

claims.text: Writing has become an escape for Joanna and a way to express her feelings and make something good out of them; she said on 14 August 2022 that words have a magical way of healing.

claims.text: In the week before 14 August 2022 someone wrote Joanna a letter after reading a blog post she had published online about a hard moment in her life, saying her story had brought them comfort; she found it moving to realise her words had that power.

claims.text: Knowing that her writing can make a difference to people is what keeps Joanna going even on tough days, as she said on 14 August 2022.

claims.text: Joanna said on 9 October 2022 that she gets super invested in small things like furnishing a room, and thinks it is worth it for the little things that make life nicer.

claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna was rejected by another production company shortly before 21 October 2022, a setback she said she would not let slow her down and would keep grinding through.

claims.text: Another film script Joanna contributed to was shown on the big screen for the first time on Sunday 23 October 2022; she called it surreal and satisfying, said she had waited a long time for it, and noted it was the third time it had happened to her.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna's favourite part of seeing her script filmed was watching the characters she had worked so hard on come alive, which she described on 25 October 2022 as totally surreal, like them jumping off the page.

claims.text: Creating stories and watching them come alive is what gives Joanna happiness and fulfilment, and she called writing a blessing on 7 November 2022.

claims.text: Joanna submitted several more scripts in the week before 7 November 2022 and was hoping to hear back soon, while assuming a few would be rejected.

claims.text: Nate upgraded some of his home computer equipment shortly before 7 November 2022; it is where he practises and competes and sometimes where he plays with friends.

claims.text: Nate had a special day taking his pets to the park before November 2022, and said seeing their amazement and happy faces made it memorable.

claims.text: Joanna worked out a plan for getting another of her scripts made into a film and pitched it to producers on 8 November 2022; they really liked it, which gave her a big confidence boost.

claims.text: Nate started creating gaming content for YouTube in November 2022, as a way to entertain people and satisfy his video game cravings between tournaments, hoping to share his love of gaming and connect with others who enjoy it.

claims.text: Joanna's screenwriting went from finishing her first screenplay in January 2022 and submitting it to festivals, through a generic rejection from a major company in June 2022 and another from a production company in October, to producer meetings and a successful pitch in November 2022 and the start of filming her own road-trip movie on 11 November 2022.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate's competitive gaming went from his first tournament win in January 2022, through a local Street Fighter win in late April, a regional win in late May, an online win on 8 July and an international win on 21 August 2022, to making a living from the game and winning a big Valorant final on 5 November 2022 — with a poor showing in early September and a missed final in early November along the way.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate's household grew through 2022 from the two turtles he had already kept for three years, to an adopted dog called Max in May, to a third turtle bought in November.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna took up dairy-free baking after Nate recommended coconut milk in February 2022 and sent her his ice cream recipe in April, and by autumn 2022 she was making cakes, tarts, cupcakes, cookies and pies for her family and friends and swapping recipes with him.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna's writing widened during 2022 from screenplays to a book she began in July, shared with her writers group in August and finished writing at the end of September 2022.
